card.name: Linking words before combined-effect terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words (be, in, is, or, a) right before a word about combined or additive effects, mostly in drug-interaction text about co-administered drugs. Also fires on the open parenthesis after And in search-syntax help.

modes.label: Before additive effect
modes.description: Small words in interaction sentences just before a term like additive, synergistic or profound sedation.
modes.example: The toxicity of co-administered local anesthetics is thought to<< be>> at least additive.
